subject: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@clearfin.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion

Hi Olivia —

Hope you’re well. Quick ask: ClearFin is coming up for renewal and you mentioned exploring expanded capacity for the fraud-detection workload. To help our executive sponsors and procurement team justify the renewal + expansion, would ClearFin be willing to provide a short customer reference or 1–2 sentence quote describing the business outcomes you’ve seen since moving inference to Redwood?

We can draft the language to make it fast — suggested bullets we’d like to call out:
- ~35% reduction in per-inference cost after batching & quantization guidance
- ~2.5x throughput at peak (reduced dropped requests during spikes)
- Median p95 latency improvement from 220ms -> 85ms, which reduced user-facing retries
- Improved reliability and predictable hourly throughput during end-of-day processing

If you’re open, we’ll send a brief draft case study and ROI spreadsheet you can edit. We only need a 15-minute approval call or an email OK; happy to anonymize metrics if that helps.

I’ve cc’d Ava (our sales lead) to keep the procurement timeline in sync. Thanks again for your partnership — the ClearFin team’s performance gains are some of the clearest outcomes we have.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ClearFin_case_study_draft.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]
[Attachment: ClearFin_ROI_spreadsheet.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]

From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@clearfin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the heads up. We’ve definitely seen the cost and latency improvements, and I’m happy to help, but two quick asks before I commit to a quote:

1) Can you send the draft text (and the ROI numbers) so I can share with my CFO/legal for a quick check?
2) Please confirm the exact metric sources/period you’re citing (we compare week-over-week after the rollout and daily averages differ).

If you can provide that, I’ll try to get a short approved quote from our VP of Product. We may need to anonymize some internal metrics but we can sign off on the high-level outcomes.

I’m out of the office Wednesday morning but can follow up late Wednesday or Thursday.

—Olivia
Olivia Harper
Director of Machine Learning, ClearFin Analytics
olivia.harper@clearfin.com
[phone redacted]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@clearfin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion

Thanks, Olivia — attaching the draft case study and a short ROI spreadsheet with sources called out. Key notes on the metrics:
- Cost savings: percent delta computed from average per-inference token cost for the 30 days before vs 30 days after the quantized variant and KV caching rollout (sourced from Redwood billing + ClearFin reported inference volume).
- Throughput: measured peak sustained requests-per-second during the week of 2026-01-18 (post-optimization) vs baseline week of 2025-12-14.
- Latency: medians and p95 from Redwood tracing for the same post-rollout week.

Attachments: ClearFin_case_study_draft.pdf (includes a two-paragraph quote placeholder) and ClearFin_ROI_spreadsheet.xlsx (tab with raw numbers and sources).

If it’s easier I can pull Marcus on a 10–15 min call to walk legal/CFO through the sources. Marcus — would you be able to join?

Thanks — will wait for your preference on anonymity.

Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@clearfin.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion

Hi Olivia — Marcus from Customer Success here. Quick note: happy to run through the numbers with your finance/legal folks and tighten the language in the draft. Proposed mutual action plan:
- We’ll revise the draft case study with the metric sourcing language you approve (by Tue 2/17).
- You review and provide any redlines (by Thu 2/19).
- We circulate final PDF for legal sign-off and logo approval.

If you prefer, I can prepare a 1-slide summary and a 5-minute walkthrough to make it straightforward for your VP/Legal to approve.

Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Attachment: none]

From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@clearfin.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@clearfin.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion

Thanks, Marcus and Soojin — this looks fine. I ran the draft past our VP of Product and legal. We’re comfortable with the high-level metrics as written (feel free to keep the exact numbers), and legal is OK with the company name + logo in the case study so long as we get a final copy for a quick sign-off.

Below is the short quote our VP approved for use in the case study:
"Redwood helped us reduce inference costs and dramatically improve throughput during peak fraud windows — the performance gains let us redirect engineering effort to model improvements rather than infra firefighting."

You have our permission to use the ClearFin name and logo and that quote. Please send the final PDF and we’ll do a quick legal/brand review (should be <48 hours).

—Olivia
Director of Machine Learning, ClearFin Analytics
[Attachment: ClearFin_approved_quote.txt (plain text)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@clearfin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference / short quote to support ClearFin renewal & expansion

Great — thank you, Olivia (and Sergio). Really appreciate the quick turnaround and the approved quote. Next steps on our side:
- We’ll finalize the case study PDF with the approved quote and ClearFin logo and share the final for brand/legal sign-off by Friday 2/20.
- We’ll attach a short one-pager for procurement that summarizes the ROI and the recommended committed capacity for the renewal (deal RDW-1357).
- I’ll loop in our finance lead if there are any invoice timing questions; otherwise we’ll proceed with the renewal schedule we discussed.

As requested, attaching the post-edit PDF for review: final_case_study_for_approval.pdf (stub). Please ping me if you want the quote worded slightly differently.

Thanks again — excited to expand capacity with ClearFin.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: final_case_study_for_approval.pdf (PDF, 265KB)]
